content.text: The change adds two hardcoded translation strings (`skipToContent` in English and Spanish) to a static UI dictionary. There is no user input, no sink (shell/SQL/eval/HTML render via innerHTML/etc.), no data flow — only literal string constants baked into the module at compile time. Consumers rendering these strings via a standard framework text node (the default across React/Astro/Svelte/Vue) will treat them as text, not markup. Nothing to flag.
